title: Evidence record
description: One observation, written by the tool that ran it. Append-only. A rerun is a new record that names the old one in supersedes. Field list follows docs/wiki/evidence.md; readback, supersedes, sample_payload and notes are lane additions.

evidence_id.description: ev-YYYYMMDD-HHMMSS-xxxx, assigned by the recorder at write time.

requirement_ids.description: IDs from docs/wiki/requirements.json. Must be a subset of the scenario's requirement_ids.

category.description: fixture is an in-process test double; mock is the deterministic mock provider transport (WHOP_MODE=mock); neither satisfies a requirement whose evidence_required names sandbox or human proof. sandbox-api is real Whop sandbox on every operation. hybrid-api means real auth and database with at least one mocked provider operation; it never counts as sandbox-api proof.

provider_mode.description: WHOP_MODE the run started with. Server-owned, captured at run start.

source.description: Provenance of this one operation, matching the instrumentation contract: sandbox or mock for Whop calls, neon or pglite for database commits, app for the app's own API. Never inherited from the run.

status.description: HTTP status for app and Whop calls; ok or error for database commits, as in the instrumentation contract.

operations.description: Per-operation provenance for hybrid runs. A sandbox-api record may list only sandbox operations. Mock ids (containing _mock_ or mock.invalid) may appear only on mock operations.

status.description: The runner may write up to passed. Only a different actor may write verified.

owner.description: Who or what ran the observation. Session or lane name, never a secret.

environment.description: local for fixture and browser runs against a local server, sandbox for Whop sandbox calls, docs for source-research.

code_revision.description: Git commit of the checkout that ran, or the literal unborn while the repo has no commits.

api_base.description: Only the sandbox base is allowed in this repo.

rest_version.description: Api-Version-Date header used for REST calls.

webhook_version.description: api_version_date pinned on the webhook subscription.

sdk_version.description: Exact package and version, for example @whop/sdk@1.2.3.

command.description: The exact command that produced the observation, after redaction.

request_reference.description: Path under artifact_paths holding the redacted request.

response_reference.description: Path under artifact_paths holding the redacted response.

provider_resource_ids.description: Nonsecret Whop identifiers returned by the provider, for example biz_, pay_, wdrl_, msg_. Never keys or tokens.

sample_payload.description: True when the observation is a Whop test-event sample rather than a business event.

artifact_hashes.description: sha256 per artifact path. Keys must equal artifact_paths.

limitations.description: What this record does not prove. Required even when empty of caveats; write none.

reference.description: Artifact path or provider resource ID the reviewer read.

readback.description: How the reviewer checked the claim independently of the runner.

run_id.description: Demo run or tour run that produced this record.

correlation_id.description: Ties the record to the initiating user action and to the instrumentation events the overlay showed.

correlation.description: Structured link to the demo-runtime event stream and the real-app instrumentation, so a record can be matched to what the overlay displayed.

blocked_by.description: Owner gate ID from docs/wiki/decisions.md, or local:<slug> for a lane-local gate such as local:credential or local:provider-client. Only G## gates are drawn as owner gates in the report.

x-generator-checks: reviewer must differ from owner when status is verified
artifact_hashes keys must equal artifact_paths and match file contents
requirement_ids must be a subset of the scenario's requirement_ids
a fixture record cannot satisfy a requirement whose evidence_required names sandbox, provider, hosted, human or actual
sample_payload true cannot satisfy SUBMIT-04 without an assessor-approved exception record
no artifact may match the secret patterns list
